params.name: states
params.description: List all environments that match a specific state. Accepted values: `available`, `stopping`, or `stopped`. If no state value given, returns all environments

items.docs: It returns 204 if the environment was successfully deleted, and 404 if the environment does not exist. This feature was introduced in GitLab 8.11.

params.name: id

params.name: before
params.description: The date before which environments can be deleted. Defaults to 30 days ago. Expected in ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of environments to delete. Defaults to 100

params.name: dry_run
params.description: Defaults to true for safety reasons. It performs a dry run where no actual deletion will be performed. Set to false to actually delete the environment

items.docs: It schedules for deletion multiple environments that have already been stopped and are in the review app folder. The actual deletion is performed after 1 week from the time of execution. By default, it only deletes environments 30 days or older. You can change this default using the `before` parameter.
